apciq.label: APCIQ · bilan 2025 · 13 janvier 2026
apciq.scope: Residential resales recorded through Centris; Québec CMA is not the municipality. Québec is included in Canada; do not add the totals.

crea.label: CREA · bilan 2025 · 15 janvier 2026
crea.scope: Annual residential transactions recorded over Canadian MLS systems, not all transactions or eligible notarial acts.

cnq.label: Chambre des notaires · rapport 2024–2025 · p. 11
cnq.scope: 2,659 individual notaries in a traditional practice, not 2,659 firms, customers or subscriptions.

cnue.label: CNUE · rapport 2024 · p. 16
cnue.scope: Nearly 50,000 notaries across 22 member notariats. An international reference pool, not a validated serviceable market.

uinl.label: UINL · organismes membres · consulté le 12 septembre 2026
uinl.scope: Member notariats; do not equate membership with launch authorization or sum with the CNUE.

signing.label: Chambre des notaires · signature électronique au bureau
signing.scope: Electronic notarial signing already exists. Electronic signing does not imply remote signing.

remote.label: Chambre des notaires · signature à distance sur exception
remote.scope: Remote notarial signing is exceptional and evaluated by the responsible notary.

csn.label: CSN · Mistral AI et Scaleway · 9 juillet 2026
csn.scope: An announced 18-month partnership for notarial AI experimentation. Evidence of an active competitive ecosystem; no measured productivity result for Nota.
